source.note: runs\ is gitignored. To rebuild the set: download zip_url to download_to, check zip_sha256, extract into extract_to (it creates Black_Myth_Wukong_Save_Files-ef4cf4add44c69631afec74f8d9881b573420b5e\), then check each rung's sha256. source_path is the file's path inside the GitHub repo at that commit. set.json and catalog.json/.md sit next to the zip.

notes: Every save is at a Keeper's Shrine before the first encounter with the boss its name gives (README); 'boss-after' rungs are the next save of the same journey.

All saves except 1.0 are one journey (8ea815f3, started 2024-11-03 on build 15179). 1.x-5.20 were last written by build 15179 (save version 10), 5.21 onward and Other by 16669 (version 12). The installed game is 23831 (version 14). The user's slot 2 was started on 16669 and still loads, and another account's SteamID inside a save does not stop it loading (slot 2 carries 76561199760740844), but no 15179/version-10 save has been tried on 23831: run c1-start and c6-start first.

Continue may not pick slot 9: the user's slot 2 was last saved 2026-10-01 and every save here is from 2024-11 to 2025-01 (header f1.5, and the copied file's mtime is whatever the copy gives it). The recipe should load the journey from the load list, or the runner should confirm which journey loaded.
The set's README says to give a copied save the next free slot number (have 3, name it .4). Slot 9 with 5-8 empty is untested; if it does not show up in the list, use slot 5.
Paths contain Chinese characters: read this file as UTF-8 (Get-Content -Encoding UTF8, as run-test.ps1 does for recipes).
6.15, 6.A.0 and 6.B.0 are byte-identical (the branch point of the two endings).
